name: txn-step-replace
$comment: Replace swaps the whole doc body (do_replace validates the new doc as a COMPLETE document and apply_update stores it verbatim — no merge, unlike patch), so the old `status` key is gone afterwards. `status` is Optional because validate_doc requires every non-Optional schema field to be present — a required field could never disappear in a legal replace. Step result is null (step_replace pushes Value::Null).
